senses.gloss: (b. h.; √אר , v. ארב; cmp. חרג) to plait, braid, weave.
units: Sabb. VII, 2 האוֹרֵג he who weaves on the Sabbath; a. fr.—Metaph. (cmp. טרי) to argue, conclude, spin out, deduct &c. Ruth R., Par. 2, beg. (play on or’gim II Sam. XXI, 19) they brought a subject up והוא אוֹרְגָהּ and he carried it to a conclusive decision.
<cite ref="II Samuel 21:19">Ib.</cite> <he>שהיו אוֹרְגִין עמו</he> they argued with him.—
Num. R. s. 4 (play on argaman, purple) שהוא היה א̇ור̇ג̇ … מ̇ן̇ וכ׳ for it (the purple-covered altar) argued Israel free from sin (pleaded in his behalf).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4">Num. R. s. 12</cite> (same play on the word) <he>והוא אורג וכ׳</he> and He wove (planned) the world so that all creatures should come forth each according to its kind.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Ib.</cite> <he>א׳ מַן</he> the Sun weaves (ripens) food.

senses.gloss: to be woven. Y. Ter. XI, end, 48ᵇ.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 50">Ex. R. s. 50</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: , part. מְאָרֵג (cmp. עֲרוּגָה) to follow the grooves of the garden bed, to range, esp. to select the green and tender onions (v. חָלַק Hif.).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 1:9">Tosef. Peah I, 9</cite> <he>המארג</he>, quoted in Y. ib. III, 17ᶜ top <he>המירוג</he> (corr. acc.; v. <cite ref="M01293"><he>מֵירוּג</he></cite>) a. explained ibid. <he>המחליק וכ׳</he> he who takes out the green onions for sale and leaves the others to ripen for storage.
